title: Lost Mary Maryliq Strawberry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Experience an enticing blend of sweet, juicy Strawberries and invigorating Ice in Lost Mary Maryliq's Strawberry Ice. This e-liquid takes one of the most beloved fruit flavours and kicks it up a notch by adding a chill factor that’s both refreshing and satisfying. From the initial inhale to the cooling exhale, Strawberry Ice is a flavourful journey that engages all your senses. Its 50% VG / 50% PG ratio guarantees a smooth throat hit and plentiful cloud production, ideal for vapers who crave a balanced, yet impactful, all-day vape.
